text:
Sam Pritchard: Quick sync — need to lock vendor onramp windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Goals: confirm availability dates for Marketplace listing, press embargo windows, SI install/test blockers. Can folks share vendor timelines + any capacity gating by EOD? Agenda: 1) timeline table, 2) embargo windows, 3) SI blockers.

Nina Chen: From infra: H100 stock expected week of 1999998000 (tentative) per Nvidia rep, H200 mid-May, MI300 end-May per AMD contact. Gaudi small batches rolling in April. I'll DM exact PO numbers.

Carlos Vega: Marketing note — we need minimum 2w lead for joint press/partner quotes. If H100 embargo is early May we need message freeze by Apr 15. Also ask partners if they can do embargo extensions.

Priya Kapoor: SI integration update: main blocker = driver/kernel mismatch on Gaudi test images. Quick repro (CI):
```
docker run --rm redwood/gaudi-test:ci ./run_tests.sh
```
Fails on mmap with 6.1 kernels. Workaround: use 5.15-based image for now.

Sam Pritchard: @Nina can you confirm if vendor can shift any shipments earlier? @Priya can you file a short bug with repro and assign to eng-ml? Also we need marketplace tile availability dates from platform.

Nina Chen: Just chatted with Nvidia rep — limited H100 until next replenishment in ~3w. Will email rep and cc team after this thread. Also asking AMD for MI300 concrete ship dates.

Carlos Vega: If we can't move H100 earlier, propose rolling announcement: GA for Gaudi & MI300 first, then H100 wave 2. Need to lock marketplace onboarding dates accordingly. Draft spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/example-onramp

Priya Kapoor: Filed RW-4567 (internal) with logs and steps, assigned to Tom Lee. Short note: kernel fallback to 5.15 fixes tests locally; long-term fix needs driver update.

Tom Lee: Looking into RW-4567 now. Will try kernel fallback in CI and post logs. ETA EOD tomorrow.

DevRel Bot: New doc created: /docs/marketplace/onramp-windows-draft.md :page_facing_up:

Sam Pritchard: Action items: Nina confirm vendor ETAs by tomorrow noon; Priya add remediation plan + temporary marketplace note; Carlos draft comms with contingency language; Tom verify CI fallback. I'll run vendor call Friday 09:00 PT to finalize windows — can everyone make it? :calendar:

Nina Chen: I can make it. Will try to have rep on the call.

Carlos Vega: 9am PT works for me. :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: OK. Tom, please post results before the call so we can decide if Gaudi/MI300 first is viable.

Tom Lee: Will post logs + CI run link in thread by EOD tomorrow.

Sam Pritchard: Thanks all — I'll send calendar invite and initial agenda after Nina confirms vendor slots.
